meaning: The campaign LIST is frozen. Status still refreshes from Twilio on the normal schedule.
rules: Never add a campaign to the tracker unless Brandon asks.
Rows not in cohort-lock.json are dropped from data.json every run.
Status, error codes, and action items for locked campaigns keep updating.
unfreeze: Brandon asks to add campaigns. Then regenerate cohort-lock.json (or run once with CAMPAIGN_TRACKER_UNFREEZE=1) and tell him what was added.
